title: Current Cloudflare security-hardening verification
summary: Targeted security and Worker regression tests, exact-revision live-route verification and fail-closed Turnstile probes passed for the deployed production revision.

checks.name: Targeted security regression suite
checks.detail: Eighty of eighty targeted Cloudflare, security-hardening, deployment-verification, Turnstile and WebMCP tests passed with no failures, skips or cancellations.

checks.name: Turnstile fail-closed boundary
checks.detail: Automated and live negative-path probes reject missing and invalid Turnstile tokens before user creation or session issuance, with bounded redacted error responses.

checks.name: Protected order and media boundary
checks.detail: Tests passed for authenticated order creation, origin and CSRF checks, bounded prescription uploads, immutable R2 storage and non-predictable media grants.

checks.name: Provider callback boundary
checks.detail: Tests passed for Twilio request signatures, canonical callback URLs, media-host allowlisting, tamper rejection, bounded bodies and delivery-finality handling.

checks.name: Exact-revision live verification
checks.detail: All ten canonical production routes passed HTTPS, security-header, indexing, PWA and release-revision checks with no verifier errors.
